campaign.title: M2 strict-UNBAL level-four Kuznetsov joint-matrix gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary fixed-level Kuznetsov, generalized-cusp Kloosterman, spectral-large-sieve, and Bessel-transform sources only after deriving the literal modulus-character embedding. Record theorem number, level, cusps, allowed moduli, Kloosterman normalization, test-function class, spectral terms, coefficient placement, exceptional spectrum, and the full D-L-R-K-Delta power ledger.

frozen_target.question: Does the fully gcd-restored inverse-selector completion of the literal flat-smooth strict-UNBAL M2 wave admit a fixed-level-four generalized-Kloosterman and Kuznetsov/spectral-large-sieve estimate that preserves chi_4 across moduli and beats the accepted envelope uniformly at the prescribed real centre; if not, what is the first exact cusp, modulus, coefficient-matrix, Bessel-transform, spectral, self-return, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let X=N_0+xi with N_0=floor X and 0<=xi<1, D=X^delta, L=X^ell, R=X/D, K=XL/D^2, Delta=D/L=R/K, and 1/4<delta-ell<1/2. The flat packet is R_(D,L)(X)=sum_(r asymp R, r odd)chi_4(r)W(X/(rD))sum_(k asymp K)q_L(4Xk/r^2)k^(-1)e(Xk/r). With r=gn, k=gj, (j,n)=1, b_(g,n)(j)=q_L(4Xj/(gn^2))(gj)^(-1)e(xi j/n), gamma_(g,n)(m)=b_(g,n)(inverse_n(m)) on units, and normalized Fourier transform gammahat_(g,n)(h), the exact inverse-first row is sum_(h mod n)gammahat_(g,n)(h)S(N_0,h;n). The full owner retains sum_(g,n odd, gn asymp R)chi_4(g)chi_4(n)W(X/(gnD)) and every gcd stratum. The target is O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)), or a strictly smaller owner-complete survivor below the accepted envelope min(Delta,sqrt(XL/D)+sqrt(X/(LD))).
quantities: The modulus sign chi_4(n) must remain inside the complete n-sum; replacing it by its modulus or an arbitrary coefficient theorem is not a signed gain.
An identity with standard or generalized Kloosterman sums is useful only after the exact level, cusps, allowed moduli, residue normalization, and all root-of-unity factors are proved.

Kuznetsov normally accepts a common Kloosterman argument and a controlled modulus test. Here gammahat_(g,n)(h) is a joint rough function of n and h created by the inverse selector; its separation cost is part of the theorem, not a free preprocessing step.
All holomorphic, Maass, Eisenstein, exceptional, oldform, continuous-spectrum, and Bessel-transform terms must be included before a spectral estimate is called owner-complete.
The real-centre repair e(xi j/n) is legal inside b_(g,n); no proof may silently set xi=0 or discard moving profiles, entries, exits, or gcd strata.

Smooth-weight-first completion is the exact Ramanujan/additive return of size Delta X^epsilon. A proposed spectral gain must not merely transform back to that identity or to the original reciprocal wave.
This round concerns one flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner only. It cannot promote sharp, clipped, starred, transition, hard-TOP, BAL, complete M9-M2, endpoint, M9, or the global theorem.

completion_criteria: Derive or refute an exact identity embedding chi_4(n)S(N_0,h;n), with n odd, into fixed-level generalized Kloosterman sums, including every cusp, modulus progression, root-of-unity factor, gcd condition, and sign.
Write the fully gcd-restored completed scalar and identify exactly which variables are spectral coefficients, Kloosterman arguments, moduli, and test-function parameters.

Prove a lawful separation or vector-valued treatment of gammahat_(g,n)(h), with explicit projective, L2, Sobolev, and endpoint costs; do not replace the inverse selector by an independent coefficient.
Audit a primary Kuznetsov/spectral-large-sieve theorem against the exact level, cusps, modulus family, test transform, common-sequence requirement, exceptional spectrum, and continuous terms.
Compute the complete D-L-R-K-Delta capacity on the full strict residual polytope and compare it both with X^(1/4) and the accepted envelope.
Restore every gcd stratum, real-centre factor, literal profile, and entry/exit term before claiming a target bound or strict reduction.
Test standard-cusp, switched-cusp, level-four, odd-modulus, h=0, (N_0,n)>1, short-h, full-h, and transform-return cases.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_level_four_spectral_reduction, or level_four_spectral_matrix_no_go.

tasks.target: Starting from the exact fully gcd-restored inverse-selector completion, derive the literal chi_4(n)-weighted generalized-Kloosterman family at fixed level and attempt a Kuznetsov/spectral-large-sieve estimate before every positive modulus norm. Either prove the quarter target on the flat packet, reduce to a strictly smaller owner-complete spectral survivor, or isolate the first exact algebraic, coefficient-matrix, transform-return, or capacity obstruction.
required_output: An exact level/cusp/modulus embedding or a proof that no such fixed-level trace formula representation exists in the required form.
A complete spectral and power ledger yielding the target, a strict owner-complete survivor, or the first rigorous no-go.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Independently decide from the frozen flat-wave and inverse-first identities whether a fixed-level trace formula or spectral large sieve can exploit the odd-modulus chi_4 sign with the literal joint gammahat_(g,n)(h) coefficient. Derive all normalizations and capacity from scratch, or prove the first exact no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-118 through Round-143 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A self-contained fixed-level Kloosterman/Kuznetsov normalization and joint-coefficient feasibility derivation.
A target estimate, strict signed spectral survivor, or first rigorous obstruction.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Audit primary fixed-level Kuznetsov, generalized-cusp Kloosterman, and spectral-large-sieve results for the exact chi_4(n)-weighted inverse-first matrix. Determine whether any theorem accepts the modulus set, cusps, joint n-h coefficient, real-centre profile, and spectral test with a target-saving full-polytope bound, or state the first precise source-hypothesis and capacity failure.
required_output: Primary-source theorem cards with exact level, cusp, modulus, transform, spectrum, coefficient, and norm hypotheses.
A usable target theorem or the first rigorous source-level/coefficient/capacity obstruction.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

review_seams.requirement: The chi_4 modulus sign is represented with exact level, cusp pair, allowed moduli, Kloosterman normalization, and root-of-unity factors, or a precise impossibility is proved.
The inverse-selector gammahat_(g,n)(h) remains literal; every separation, Sobolev, projective, L2, and endpoint cost is explicit.
The geometric and every spectral term match a primary theorem, including Bessel transforms, exceptional spectrum, continuous terms, and common coefficient requirements.
All R, K, Delta, D, L, g, h, level, cusp, and spectral-width powers are computed on the full strict residual polytope.
Every gcd stratum, real-centre factor, profile, entry and exit is restored, and Ramanujan, original-wave, or trace-formula self-return is distinguished from a gain.
Only the flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner or a proved strict survivor may change; every omitted owner and global exponent remains unchanged.
